title: Probability norm under product distributions
statement: Let $A$ and $B$ be finite sets, let $\pi_A$ and $\pi_B$ be probability distributions on them, let $p>0$, and let $f:A\times B\to\mathbb R$. For the product distribution $\pi_A\times\pi_B$ and the probability norm $\|f\|_{p,\pi}=\left(\sum_x\pi(x)|f(x)|^p\right)^{1/p}$, one has $\|f\|_{p,\pi_A\times\pi_B}=\left\|a\mapsto\|b\mapsto f(a,b)\|_{p,\pi_B}\right\|_{p,\pi_A}$.
hypotheses_covered: $\pi_A$ and $\pi_B$ are probability distributions on $A$ and $B$
$f$ is a real-valued function on $A\times B$
